name: Ginza Sushi
notes: Photo 1 and photo 5 actually show a different, neighboring business's menu ('Gintaro Chinese Kitchen', plus a hand-written 'New Phone Number' note next to its menu) and were excluded as not belonging to this restaurant. Photos 2 and 3 are the two sides of Ginza Sushi's own trifold menu (4 panels each); photo 4 is a clearer close-up re-shot of photo 3's glare-damaged Meat/Fowl and Seafood section and was used as the authoritative price source for those two sections since its numbers differ from (and are more legible than) the same section in photo 3. In the Fresh Roll list, California/Vegetable/Scallop/Philadelphia/Hamachi Roll share the printed $4.59 price and Salmon/Smoked Salmon/Shrimp/Crab/Tuna Roll share $5.99, inferred from the pairing pattern of the printed numbers (all clearly legible, just sparsely printed once per matching price). Choice-style entries (Mix N' Match Combo components, Chicken/Beef preparation choices) were kept as one priced dish with the choices listed in the description rather than duplicated as separate dishes.
